name: bip39-explorer
description: An offline explorer for the BIP-39 English wordlist: a Go server serving an installable PWA over a precomputed relation graph.
author: Chinmay Manjunath

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build:single && npm run build:embed && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: cd server && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X github.com/chinmay28/bip39-explorer/server/internal/version.Patch=$(node ../scripts/version.mjs --patch)" -o bin/bip39-explorer ./cmd/bip39-explorer
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:index && npm run test:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run vet:server
